n_clients: <int> Number of clients that must each be assigned to a server.
n_servers: <int> Number of servers available to process client demands.
out_of_star_density: <float> Fraction of cross-server assignment pairs that carry a nonzero pairwise interaction cost.
demands: <list[float], length n_clients> Processing demand of each client.
processing_rates: <list[float], length n_servers> Processing rate of each server.
linear_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [n_clients][n_servers]> Cost of assigning each client to each server, equal to the product of the client's demand and the server's processing rate.
quadratic_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [n_quadratic_pairs][5]> Pairwise interaction costs, where each entry is [client_1, server_1, client_2, server_2, cost] representing the joint cost incurred when client_1 is assigned to server_1 and client_2 is assigned to server_2 simultaneously.
